name: Chennai
tagline: Gateway to the South, where the Bay of Bengal meets Carnatic culture
description: Tamil Nadu's capital pairs one of the world's longest urban beaches with Dravidian temples, colonial-era landmarks and a famous food scene. It is also the natural base for day trips down the East Coast Road to the UNESCO shore temples of Mahabalipuram.
climate: Hot and humid; pleasant in winter

attractions.name: Marina Beach
attractions.description: A 13 km sweep of sand best visited at sunrise or for the evening snack stalls.

attractions.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
attractions.description: 7th-century Dravidian temple in Mylapore with a vivid gopuram.

attractions.name: Fort St. George & Museum
attractions.description: The first English fortress in India, now housing a museum of colonial artefacts.

attractions.name: Government Museum, Egmore
attractions.description: Renowned Chola bronze gallery and the National Art Gallery.

attractions.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
attractions.description: UNESCO World Heritage granite temples on the coast, 55 km down the ECR.

attractions.name: DakshinaChitra Heritage Museum
attractions.description: Living museum of South Indian homes, crafts and performing arts.

attractions.name: T. Nagar & Pondy Bazaar
attractions.description: Silk sarees, temple jewellery and street food in Chennai's busiest market.

attractions.name: Besant Nagar (Elliot's) Beach
attractions.description: Quieter beach with cafes and the Ashtalakshmi temple.

name: Madurai
tagline: The temple city that never sleeps
description: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, Madurai grew around the Meenakshi Amman temple. Expect towering gopurams, Nayak-era palaces, the Keeladi excavations nearby and late-night street food such as jigarthanda and bun parotta.
climate: Hot through most of the year; cooler winter evenings

attractions.name: Meenakshi Amman Temple
attractions.description: Fourteen gopurams and the Hall of a Thousand Pillars at the heart of the old city.

attractions.name: Thirumalai Nayakkar Mahal
attractions.description: 17th-century palace with an evening sound-and-light show.

attractions.name: Gandhi Memorial Museum
attractions.description: Holds the blood-stained dhoti Gandhi wore when he was assassinated.

attractions.name: Vandiyur Mariamman Teppakulam
attractions.description: Huge temple tank with a central mandapam, site of the float festival.

attractions.name: Thiruparankundram Murugan Temple
attractions.description: Rock-cut cave temple, one of the six abodes of Lord Murugan.

attractions.name: Keeladi Excavation Museum
attractions.description: Finds from a 2,600-year-old Sangam-era urban settlement.

attractions.name: Madurai Night Food Walk
attractions.description: Kari dosa, bun parotta and jigarthanda around the temple streets.

name: Kodaikanal
description: A misty hill station at 2,133 m in the Palani Hills, built around a star-shaped lake. Pine forests, cliff-edge walks, waterfalls and homemade chocolates make it a favourite for couples and families escaping the plains.
bestTimeToVisit: April to June, September to October
climate: Cool all year; cold nights from November to February

attractions.name: Kodaikanal Lake
attractions.description: Boating and cycling around the star-shaped lake.

attractions.name: Coaker's Walk
attractions.description: Cliff-side promenade with views down to the plains on clear days.

attractions.name: Pillar Rocks
attractions.description: Three 120 m granite pillars that drift in and out of the mist.

attractions.name: Bryant Park
attractions.description: Botanical garden with a glasshouse and hybrid roses.

attractions.name: Pine Forest
attractions.description: Tall planted pines that make a dramatic walk on foggy afternoons.

attractions.name: Berijam Lake
attractions.description: Protected forest lake reached by permit-only jeep track.

attractions.name: Silver Cascade Falls
attractions.description: 180 ft waterfall on the ghat road into town.

attractions.name: Dolphin's Nose Trek
attractions.description: Downhill trek through Vattakanal to a flat rock overhanging the valley.

name: Thanjavur
tagline: Rice bowl and royal seat of the Great Cholas
description: Capital of the Chola empire and home to the 1,000-year-old Brihadeeswarar Temple. Thanjavur is the base for the Great Living Chola Temples circuit, Tanjore paintings, bronze casting and classical Carnatic music.
climate: Warm; best in the winter months

attractions.name: Brihadeeswarar Temple
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed Chola masterpiece with a 66 m granite vimana.

attractions.name: Thanjavur Maratha Palace
attractions.description: Palace complex with the Saraswathi Mahal library and an art gallery of Chola bronzes.

attractions.name: Airavatesvara Temple, Darasuram
attractions.description: Intricately carved Chola temple near Kumbakonam.

attractions.name: Gangaikonda Cholapuram
attractions.description: Rajendra Chola's capital temple, the third of the Great Living Chola Temples.

attractions.name: Schwartz Church
attractions.description: 18th-century Danish mission church inside the palace gardens.

attractions.name: Tanjore Painting Workshop
attractions.description: Hands-on session with a gold-leaf Tanjore painting artisan.

name: Bangalore
tagline: Garden City with a craft-beer heart
description: India's tech capital is also a city of parks, palaces and cafes. Lalbagh and Cubbon Park, the Tudor-style Bangalore Palace and a thriving microbrewery scene sit within easy reach of Nandi Hills sunrise drives.

attractions.name: Bangalore Palace
attractions.description: Tudor-style palace of the Wadiyars with an audio-guided tour.

attractions.name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
attractions.description: 240-acre garden with a Victorian glasshouse and ancient rock outcrop.

attractions.name: Cubbon Park
attractions.description: Leafy central park lined with colonial buildings.

attractions.name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
attractions.description: Teak-pillared Indo-Islamic summer residence.

attractions.name: Nandi Hills Sunrise
attractions.description: Pre-dawn drive to watch the sun rise over a sea of clouds.

attractions.name: VV Puram Food Street
attractions.description: Evening street of dosas, holige and gulkand treats.

attractions.name: Indiranagar Microbrewery Trail
attractions.description: Hop between the city's best-known craft breweries.

name: Kanyakumari
tagline: Land's End where three seas meet
description: The southern tip of mainland India, where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal and Indian Ocean converge. Famous for sunrise and sunset over the same horizon, the Vivekananda Rock Memorial and the giant Thiruvalluvar statue.
climate: Warm and breezy; monsoon showers June to September

attractions.name: Vivekananda Rock Memorial
attractions.description: Ferry out to the rock where Swami Vivekananda meditated in 1892.

attractions.name: Thiruvalluvar Statue
attractions.description: 133 ft stone statue of the Tamil poet-philosopher.

attractions.name: Sunrise at Triveni Sangamam
attractions.description: Watch the sun rise where three seas meet.

attractions.name: Kumari Amman Temple
attractions.description: 3,000-year-old shrine to the virgin goddess on the shore.

attractions.name: Padmanabhapuram Palace
attractions.description: Largest wooden palace in Asia, once the Travancore royal seat.

attractions.name: Vattakottai Fort
attractions.description: Seaside granite fort with views over the Western Ghats.

attractions.name: Sunset Point
attractions.description: Western shore spot for the Arabian Sea sunset.
